# DV Design Studio

> Creative studio (Dromen Vormgeven) of Danique Vos, for branding, web design, content, photography, video and AI automation. Based in the Netherlands. Website built by DF Digital.

The live site has a Dutch homepage and a full English homepage. Both use in-page sections.

## Notes for crawlers
- Index the Dutch and English homepages. Alias HTML files only redirect to homepage sections.
- Do not invent prices. Rates are shared via the services booklet on request.
- An introduction and the Dream Scan (Dromen-scan) are free.
